best_idea: Describe the HUD as a short list of anchored panels bound to named stats, each with ordered colour bands and a per-frame flash plate, so one table drives every mode and the 375-wide phone layout is data.
decision_why: Keep the data-driven panel table as a client module fed by the engine snapshot; reject sending the layout program from the server, because the HUD is client-only; the donor's dead ammo-flash bit and digit-truncation defect are fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: At 375 wide with health 25 the health number flashes green/red; at health 0 it is solid red; with armour 0 the armour panel is absent; a server test asserts the engine snapshot sets the ammo flash bit when ammo drops; a unit test shows a 1234 value in a 3-digit field as 999, not 123.
